prompt: 9:16 portrait photograph. A small railed ring of grass beside a grandstand: the winners' enclosure. In the middle stands a steaming bay racehorse, a large rosette pinned to its bridle, a groom holding its head. Its saddlecloth reads HOUSES in big plain capitals, the only readable word in the picture. Around it a group of well-dressed owners celebrate: a man in a morning suit and top hat pops a bottle of champagne, foam spraying; women in fitted coats and fascinators raise glasses and laugh; the jockey, face turned away, unbuckles the saddle. Umbrellas held over the owners, wet grass, a crowd behind the rails in raincoats. Grey drizzly light with a few camera flashes. Real-looking press photograph. Thanks.
